notes.tool: tools/deploy-pontes/vault_pontes.py (validate / args / verify); the owner deploys with forge, never an agent
notes.units: 1 unit = 1e6 vault units (6 decimals); the asset is USD Coin at 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831, read on-chain and on the issuer's page on 2026-11-16
notes.cap: proposed 100,000 USDC, must equal the L2 supplyCap (busdc-mainnet.config.json, validated); the vault refuses deposits above it
notes.windowLimit: proposed 10,000 USDC per 24 h = the L2 token bucket: the release token bucket (capacity; full refill in windowSeconds): a colluding release quorum takes at most this plus the refill; it is also the largest single deposit (the vault refuses more) and must equal the L2 bucketCapacity, which is the largest single burn (validated)
notes.switchThreshold: 6 of 7 (owner decision 2026-11-02, validated on mainnet): one more than the release threshold to end a pause early and to propose or cancel the one-way light-client switch
notes.switchDelay: proposed 14 days (contract minimum 7 days): time for users and guardians to react to a proposed verifier (owner decision)
notes.guard: three independent pause-only guardians (BR-6, owner decision 2026-11-02): one Ethereum vault guardian key per guardian operator, the same 3 operators who hold the L2 token guardian keys; each runs guardiao.py (fast path, vault_pause_on_mint true) and sombra.py (proof path) runs beside it once ported; 72 h pause, 72 h cooldown, as the L2 token. validate refuses another count on mainnet. The guardian set is immutable
notes.minDeposit: 21 units, l2MinBurn 20 (fee schedule of 2026-11-17, coordinator, agents/347-fee-economics-r17.md): immutable. The deploy tool refuses an l2MinBurn below the relayer cost of a release at the gas ceiling divided by (1 - releaseBps / 10000) (tools/evm-nets/networks.json relayCost.formula).
notes.TBD-owner: source.revision; deployer.address; deployer.fundedBy.safe; the 7 release signers and 3 guardians (the SAME addresses as in deployments/mainnet/busdc-vault-mainnet.config.json); confirm cap, windowLimit, switchDelay
notes.provenance: mode 1: the vault keeps a hash chain over its deposits and pays a burn only if the burn states the same chain (BridgedStablecoinV3). Deposit ids carry the vault nonce in their top 8 bytes. releaseDelay 0 and no mintVerifier: options 2 and 3 are not the launch design
notes.fees: 5 bps of each deposit and 5 bps of each release (fee schedule of 2026-11-17), paid on Arbitrum One to 0x775a993F09Bd80aeCF8F8c2ADe0C84158E3a0544 (the owner's address for every EVM network, given 2026-11-16; a single externally owned address by the owner's choice). A constructor argument: immutable once deployed.
notes.network: Arbitrum One (chain 42161). In this file the key `ethereum` names the SOURCE network, to keep one config format and one tool for every EVM source. Same committee keys, same limits and same fee as the Ethereum bridge; a separate vault, a separate L2 token and separate books (round 16, isolation).
notes.contract: ProvenanceSourceVault, byte-identical to the Ethereum bridge (creation keccak 0x901d52d0…3a74). A release certificate must land within 256 blocks of its anchor: about 3072 s on this network (docs/BRIDGE-EVM-NETWORKS.md section 4)
